```lean
def centralPoly5_33 (u : ℚ) : ℚ := residueSmall5 35 ((5:ℚ)*u+(5)) - residueSmall5 21 ((3:ℚ)*u+(3)) - residueSmall5 20 ((3:ℚ)*u+(3)) - residueSmall5 19 ((3:ℚ)*u+(3)) - residueSmall5 18 ((3:ℚ)*u+(3)) - residueSmall5 12 ((3:ℚ)*u+(3)) + residueSmall5 6 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) + residueSmall5 5 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) + residueSmall5 4 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) + residueSmall5 58 ((1:ℚ)*u+(0)) + residueSmall5 4 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) + residueSmall5 3 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) + residueSmall5 57 ((1:ℚ)*u+(0)) + residueSmall5 2 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) + residueSmall5 56 ((1:ℚ)*u+(0)) + residueSmall5 55 ((1:ℚ)*u+(0))

theorem centralTransfer5_33 (u : ℕ) :
    (h (4*(30*u+33)+2) 5 (10*(30*u+33)+5):ℚ)=centralPoly5_33 u := by
  rw [h5_central _ (by omega)]
  push_cast
  simp (disch := omega) only [small5_extension]
  have ht0 : extensionSmall5 ((10:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(5))=
      residueSmall5 35 ((5:ℚ)*u+(5)) := by
    convert small5_affine 5 (335) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht1 : extensionSmall5 ((6:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(3))=
      residueSmall5 21 ((3:ℚ)*u+(3)) := by
    convert small5_affine 3 (201) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht2 : extensionSmall5 ((6:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(2))=
      residueSmall5 20 ((3:ℚ)*u+(3)) := by
    convert small5_affine 3 (200) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht3 : extensionSmall5 ((6:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(1))=
      residueSmall5 19 ((3:ℚ)*u+(3)) := by
    convert small5_affine 3 (199) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht4 : extensionSmall5 ((6:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(0))=
      residueSmall5 18 ((3:ℚ)*u+(3)) := by
    convert small5_affine 3 (198) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht5 : extensionSmall5 ((6:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(-6))=
      residueSmall5 12 ((3:ℚ)*u+(3)) := by
    convert small5_affine 3 (192) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht6 : extensionSmall5 ((2:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(0))=
      residueSmall5 6 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) := by
    convert small5_affine 1 (66) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht7 : extensionSmall5 ((2:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(-1))=
      residueSmall5 5 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) := by
    convert small5_affine 1 (65) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht8 : extensionSmall5 ((2:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(-2))=
      residueSmall5 4 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) := by
    convert small5_affine 1 (64) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht9 : extensionSmall5 ((2:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(-8))=
      residueSmall5 58 ((1:ℚ)*u+(0)) := by
    convert small5_affine 1 (58) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht10 : extensionSmall5 ((2:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(-2))=
      residueSmall5 4 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) := by
    convert small5_affine 1 (64) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht11 : extensionSmall5 ((2:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(-3))=
      residueSmall5 3 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) := by
    convert small5_affine 1 (63) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht12 : extensionSmall5 ((2:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(-9))=
      residueSmall5 57 ((1:ℚ)*u+(0)) := by
    convert small5_affine 1 (57) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht13 : extensionSmall5 ((2:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(-4))=
      residueSmall5 2 ((1:ℚ)*u+(1)) := by
    convert small5_affine 1 (62) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht14 : extensionSmall5 ((2:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(-10))=
      residueSmall5 56 ((1:ℚ)*u+(0)) := by
    convert small5_affine 1 (56) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  have ht15 : extensionSmall5 ((2:ℤ)*(30*u+33)+(-11))=
      residueSmall5 55 ((1:ℚ)*u+(0)) := by
    convert small5_affine 1 (55) u using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf
  unfold centralPoly5_33
  ring_nf at ht0 ht1 ht2 ht3 ht4 ht5 ht6 ht7 ht8 ht9 ht10 ht11 ht12 ht13 ht14 ht15 ⊢
  simp only [ht0, ht1, ht2, ht3, ht4, ht5, ht6, ht7, ht8, ht9, ht10, ht11, ht12, ht13, ht14, ht15]

def centralData5_33 : NewtonData := ⟨85,[(1,0,235), (2,0,150), (3,0,0)]⟩

theorem centralSigns5_33 : checkNewton centralData5_33=true := by decide +kernel

theorem centralIdentity5_33 (u v : ℚ) : centralPoly5_33 u=newtonEval centralData5_33 u v := by
  norm_num [centralPoly5_33,residueSmall5,cSmall5_2,binomEval,falling,Nat.factorial,newtonEval,centralData5_33]
  ring

theorem centralCase5_33 (u : ℕ) : 0<h (4*(30*u+33)+2) 5 (10*(30*u+33)+5) := by
  have hh := certified_positive centralData5_33 (fun u _ => centralPoly5_33 u)
    centralIdentity5_33 centralSigns5_33 u 0
  rw [← centralTransfer5_33] at hh
  exact_mod_cast hh

end ChenJia
```

### `CJSemigroups.lean`

```lean
import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases

namespace ChenJia

def S34 (c : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ a b : ℕ, c=3*a+4*b
def S456 (c : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ a b d : ℕ, c=4*a+5*b+6*d

theorem S34_tail (c : ℕ) (hc : 6≤c) : S34 c := by
  induction c using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h c ih =>
    by_cases hh : 9≤c
    · obtain ⟨a,b,he⟩ := ih (c-3) (by omega) (by omega)
      exact ⟨a+1,b,by omega⟩
    · have hu : c≤8 := by omega
      interval_cases c
      · exact ⟨2,0,rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1,1,rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨0,2,rfl⟩

theorem S456_tail (c : ℕ) (hc : 8≤c) : S456 c := by
  induction c using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h c ih =>
    by_cases hh : 12≤c
    · obtain ⟨a,b,d,he⟩ := ih (c-4) (by omega) (by omega)
      exact ⟨a+1,b,d,by omega⟩
    · have hu : c≤11 := by omega
      interval_cases c
      · exact ⟨2,0,0,rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1,1,0,rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨0,2,0,rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨0,1,1,rfl⟩

end ChenJia
```

### `CJPrime.lean`

```lean
import CJAlgebra
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.IrreducibleQuadratic
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.UniqueFactorization

open MvPolynomial
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

def pairExp {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n+1)) : Fin (n+1) →₀ ℕ :=
  Finsupp.single i 1 + Finsupp.single (Fin.rev i) 1

theorem Q_monomials (n : ℕ) : Q n = ∑ i : Fin (n+1),
    monomial (pairExp i) (((-1:ℚ)^i.val)*(n.choose i.val : ℚ)) := by
  simp only [Q, pairExp, MvPolynomial.X, C_apply, monomial_mul_monomial,
    zero_add, mul_one]

theorem pairExp_rev {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n+1)) : pairExp (Fin.rev i)=pairExp i := by
  simp [pairExp, add_comm]

theorem pairExp_at {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin (n+1)) :
    pairExp i j = (if i=j then 1 else 0)+(if Fin.rev i=j then 1 else 0) := by
  simp [pairExp, Finsupp.single_apply]

theorem pairExp_eq_iff {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin (n+1)) :
    pairExp i=pairExp j ↔ i=j ∨ i=Fin.rev j := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hi := congrArg (fun e => e i) h
    simp only [pairExp_at] at hi
    split_ifs at hi <;> simp_all
  · rintro (rfl|rfl)
    · rfl
    · exact pairExp_rev j

theorem Q_support_pair {n : ℕ} {ν : Fin (n+1) →₀ ℕ} (hν : ν∈(Q n).support) :
    ∃ i, ν=pairExp i := by
  have h := MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hν
  rw [Q_monomials, coeff_sum] at h
  obtain ⟨i,_,hi⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h
  by_cases he : pairExp i=ν
  · exact ⟨i,he.symm⟩
  · simp [coeff_monomial, he] at hi

theorem Q_pairwise (n : ℕ) :
    ((Q n).support : Set (Fin (n+1) →₀ ℕ)).PairwiseDisjoint Finsupp.support := by
  intro ν hν μ hμ hne
  obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := Q_support_pair hν
  obtain ⟨j,rfl⟩ := Q_support_pair hμ
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro a ha hb
  have ha' : i=a ∨ Fin.rev i=a := by
    simpa only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, pairExp_at, ne_eq, ite_eq_right_iff,
      Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, not_and_or, not_forall, not_not, one_ne_zero, imp_false] using ha
  have hb' : j=a ∨ Fin.rev j=a := by
    simpa only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, pairExp_at, ne_eq, ite_eq_right_iff,
      Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, not_and_or, not_forall, not_not, one_ne_zero, imp_false] using hb
  apply hne
  apply (pairExp_eq_iff i j).mpr
  rcases ha' with ha'|ha' <;> rcases hb' with hb'|hb'
  · exact Or.inl (ha'.trans hb'.symm)
  · exact Or.inr (ha'.trans hb'.symm)
  · exact Or.inr (by rw [← Fin.rev_rev i, ha', ← hb'])
  · exact Or.inl (Fin.rev_injective (ha'.trans hb'.symm))


theorem Q_coeff_pair {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n+1)) (hi : i≠Fin.rev i) :
    (Q n).coeff (pairExp i) =
      ((-1:ℚ)^i.val)*(n.choose i.val : ℚ) +
        ((-1:ℚ)^(Fin.rev i).val)*(n.choose (Fin.rev i).val : ℚ) := by
  rw [Q_monomials, coeff_sum]
  have he : (∑ j ∈ ({i,Fin.rev i} : Finset (Fin (n+1))),
      (monomial (pairExp j) (((-1:ℚ)^j.val)*(n.choose j.val : ℚ))).coeff (pairExp i)) =
      ∑ j : Fin (n+1),
      (monomial (pairExp j) (((-1:ℚ)^j.val)*(n.choose j.val : ℚ))).coeff (pairExp i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
    intro j hj hji
    have hn : pairExp j≠pairExp i := by
      rw [Ne, pairExp_eq_iff j i]
      simpa only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] using hji
    simp only [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right hn]
  rw [← he, Finset.sum_pair hi]
  simp only [coeff_monomial, pairExp_rev, ite_true]

theorem Q_coeff_middle {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n+1)) (hi : i=Fin.rev i) :
    (Q n).coeff (pairExp i) = ((-1:ℚ)^i.val)*(n.choose i.val : ℚ) := by
  rw [Q_monomials, coeff_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp only [coeff_monomial, ite_true]
  · intro j _ hji
    have hn : pairExp j≠pairExp i := by
      rw [Ne, pairExp_eq_iff j i, ← hi]
      exact not_or.mpr ⟨hji,hji⟩
    simp only [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right hn]
  · simp


theorem Q_prime (n : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n) : Prime (Q n) := by
  classical
  let a : Fin (n+1) := ⟨0,by omega⟩
  let b : Fin (n+1) := ⟨n/2,by omega⟩
  have ha : a≠Fin.rev a := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [a, Fin.val_rev] at this
    omega
  have hb : b=Fin.rev b := by
    apply Fin.ext
    have hh : 2∣n := even_iff_two_dvd.mp he
    have hh' := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hh
    simp only [b, Fin.val_rev]
    omega
  have hca : (Q n).coeff (pairExp a)=2 := by
    rw [Q_coeff_pair a ha]
    simp only [a, Fin.val_rev, Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_zero, Nat.choose_zero_right,
      Nat.choose_self, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
    rw [he.neg_one_pow]
    norm_num
  have hcb : (Q n).coeff (pairExp b)≠0 := by
    rw [Q_coeff_middle b hb]
    apply mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.choose_pos (Nat.le_of_lt_succ b.isLt)).ne'
  have hne : pairExp a≠pairExp b := by
    rw [Ne, pairExp_eq_iff a b, ← hb]
    have : a≠b := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp only [a,b] at this
      omega
    exact not_or.mpr ⟨this,this⟩
  have hir : Irreducible (Q n) := MvPolynomial.irreducible_of_disjoint_support
    (by
      refine ⟨pairExp a, ?_, pairExp b, ?_, hne⟩
      · exact MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr (by rw [hca]; norm_num)
      · exact MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hcb)
    (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr (by rw [hca]; norm_num))
    (i := a) (by simp [pairExp_at, Ne.symm ha]) (Q_pairwise n)
    (by
      intro r hr
      apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
      intro h
      have ht := hr (pairExp a)
      rw [h, hca, zero_dvd_iff] at ht
      norm_num at ht)
  exact hir.prime

end ChenJia
```

```lean
import CJPrime

open MvPolynomial
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

theorem nonzeroClass_add {n k l m t : ℕ} (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n) :
    NonzeroClass n k m → NonzeroClass n l t → NonzeroClass n (k+l) (m+t) :=
  nonzeroClass_add_of_prime (Q_prime n hn he)

theorem D_Q_all (n : ℕ) : D n (Q n)=0 := by
  classical
  have hd : D n (Q n) =
      (∑ i : Fin (n+1), C (((-1:ℚ)^i.val)*(n.choose i.val : ℚ)) *
        D n (X i) * X (Fin.rev i)) +
      (∑ i : Fin (n+1), C (((-1:ℚ)^i.val)*(n.choose i.val : ℚ)) *
        X i * D n (X (Fin.rev i))) := by
    rw [Q, map_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp only [Derivation.leibniz, MvPolynomial.derivation_C, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hd]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ (f := fun i : Fin (n+1) =>
    C (((-1:ℚ)^i.val)*(n.choose i.val : ℚ))*D n (X i)*X (Fin.rev i))]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc (f := fun i : Fin (n+1) =>
    C (((-1:ℚ)^i.val)*(n.choose i.val : ℚ))*X i*D n (X (Fin.rev i)))]
  simp only [D_X, Fin.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul, mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add,
    Fin.rev_last, add_zero]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  have hc : ((-1:ℚ)^(i.val+1))*(n.choose (i.val+1) : ℚ)*(i.val+1) +
      ((-1:ℚ)^i.val)*(n.choose i.val : ℚ)*(n-i.val)=0 := by
    have hh := Nat.choose_succ_right_eq n i.val
    have hhq := congrArg (fun x : ℕ => (x:ℚ)) hh
    push_cast [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.le_of_lt i.isLt)] at hhq
    rw [pow_succ]
    calc
      _ = -((-1:ℚ)^i.val)*((n.choose (i.val+1):ℚ)*(i.val+1)) +
          ((-1:ℚ)^i.val)*((n.choose i.val:ℚ)*(n-i.val)) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hhq]; ring
  simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_rev, smul_eq_C_mul]
  have hi := i.isLt
  have he₁ : (⟨(i.val+1)-1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n+1))=i.castSucc := by ext; simp
  have he₂ : (⟨(Fin.rev i.castSucc).val-1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n+1))=Fin.rev i.succ := by
    ext
    simp only [Fin.val_rev, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
    omega
  simp only [Fin.val_rev, Fin.val_castSucc] at he₂
  rw [he₁, he₂]
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_add_right, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
    Nat.cast_sub (Nat.le_of_lt hi)]
  calc
    _ = C (((-1:ℚ)^(i.val+1))*(n.choose (i.val+1) : ℚ)*(i.val+1) +
        ((-1:ℚ)^i.val)*(n.choose i.val : ℚ)*(n-i.val)) * X i.castSucc * X i.succ.rev := by
      simp only [map_add, map_mul]
      ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [hc, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul]


theorem D_Q (n : ℕ) (_he : Even n) : D n (Q n)=0 := D_Q_all n

theorem semi_div_Q (n : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n) {f g : R n}
    (hf : D n f=0) (hfg : f=Q n*g) : D n g=0 :=
  semi_div_of_Q (Q_prime n hn he).ne_zero (D_Q_all n) hf hfg

end ChenJia
```

```lean
import CJInvariant

open MvPolynomial
noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

theorem Q_not_dvd_small {n : ℕ} {f : R n} (hf : f≠0) (hd : f.totalDegree<2) : ¬Q n∣f := by
  intro ⟨g,hg⟩
  have hq : Q n≠0 := by intro h; rw [h,zero_mul] at hg; exact hf hg
  have hn : g≠0 := by intro h; rw [h,mul_zero] at hg; exact hf hg
  obtain ⟨ν,hν⟩ := MvPolynomial.support_nonempty.mpr hq
  have h₂ : 2≤(Q n).totalDegree := by
    have ht := MvPolynomial.le_totalDegree hν
    have he : deg ν=2 := (Q_mem n hν).1
    simpa only [deg] using he ▸ ht
  have ht := congrArg MvPolynomial.totalDegree hg
  rw [totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain hq hn] at ht
  omega

theorem nonzeroClass_one (n : ℕ) : NonzeroClass n 1 0 := by
  let i : Fin (n+1) := ⟨0,by omega⟩
  refine ⟨X i,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · change monomial (Finsupp.single i 1) (1:ℚ)∈piece n 1 0
    apply monomial_piece_of_degrees
    · simp [deg]
    · simp [weight,i]
  · simp [D_X,i]
  · apply Q_not_dvd_small
    · exact X_ne_zero i
    · simp

theorem nonzeroClass_zero (n : ℕ) : NonzeroClass n 0 0 := by
  refine ⟨1,?_,by simp,?_⟩
  · change monomial 0 (1:ℚ)∈piece n 0 0
    apply monomial_piece_of_degrees <;> simp [deg,weight]
  · apply Q_not_dvd_small one_ne_zero
    simp

theorem nonzeroClass_pad {n k m l : ℕ} (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n) :
    NonzeroClass n k m → NonzeroClass n (k+l) m := by
  intro hf
  induction l with
  | zero => simpa using hf
  | succ l ih =>
    simpa only [Nat.add_zero,Nat.add_assoc] using nonzeroClass_add hn he ih (nonzeroClass_one n)

end ChenJia
```

### `CJCommutator.lean`

```lean
import CJAdjoint
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Lie

open MvPolynomial
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false
namespace ChenJia

theorem up_X (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    up n (X i) = ((n-i.val:ℕ):ℚ) •
      X ⟨min (i.val+1) n, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (min_le_right _ _)⟩ := by
  simp [up]

theorem commutator_X (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    D n (up n (X i))-up n (D n (X i)) = ((n:ℚ)-2*i.val) • X i := by
  rw [up_X, D_X, Derivation.map_smul, Derivation.map_smul, D_X, up_X]
  simp only [Fin.val_mk]
  by_cases h₀ : i.val=0
  · have hi : i=(⟨0,by omega⟩ : Fin (n+1)) := Fin.ext h₀
    rw [hi]
    simp only [Fin.val_mk]
    by_cases hn : n=0
    · subst n
      simp
    · simp only [Fin.val_mk, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul, map_zero, sub_zero,
        zero_add, mul_zero, min_eq_left (show 0+1≤n by omega)]
      simp only [Nat.cast_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel, one_smul]
  · by_cases htop : i.val=n
    · have hp : min (n-1+1) n=i.val := by omega
      have he : (⟨min (n-1+1) n, by omega⟩ : Fin (n+1))=i := Fin.ext hp
      simp only [htop, Nat.sub_self, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul, zero_sub]
      rw [he]
      have hs : n-(n-1)=1 := by omega
      simp only [hs, Nat.cast_one, one_smul]
      module
    · have hi : i.val<n := by omega
      have hp : min (i.val+1) n=i.val+1 := min_eq_left (by omega)
      have hm : min (i.val-1+1) n=i.val := by omega
      have he₁ : (⟨min (i.val+1) n-1, Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.sub_le _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))⟩ : Fin (n+1))=i := by
        apply Fin.ext
        change min (i.val+1) n-1=i.val
        omega
      have he₂ : (⟨min (i.val-1+1) n, by omega⟩ : Fin (n+1))=i := Fin.ext hm
      rw [he₁, he₂]
      simp only [hp]
      rw [show n-(i.val-1)=n-i.val+1 by omega]
      push_cast [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.le_of_lt hi), Nat.cast_sub (show 1≤i.val by omega),
        Nat.cast_sub (show 1≤n by omega)]
      module


def Hder (n : ℕ) : Derivation ℚ (R n) (R n) :=
  mkDerivation ℚ (fun i => ((n:ℚ)-2*i.val) • X i)

theorem commutator_derivation (n : ℕ) : ⁅D n, up n⁆=Hder n := by
  apply MvPolynomial.derivation_ext
  intro i
  rw [Derivation.commutator_apply, commutator_X]
  simp [Hder]

theorem Hder_monomial (n : ℕ) (ν : Fin (n+1) →₀ ℕ) (a : ℚ) :
    Hder n (monomial ν a) = ((n:ℚ)*deg ν-2*weight ν) • monomial ν a := by
  classical
  rw [Hder, mkDerivation_monomial, Finsupp.sum]
  have ht (i : Fin (n+1)) (hi : i∈ν.support) :
      (monomial (ν-Finsupp.single i 1) (ν i:ℚ) : R n) • (((n:ℚ)-2*i.val) • X i) =
        ((ν i:ℚ)*((n:ℚ)-2*i.val)) • (monomial ν 1 : R n) := by
    have hv : Finsupp.single i 1≤ν := by
      rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff]
      have := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi
      omega
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_C_mul, C_apply, MvPolynomial.X,
      monomial_mul_monomial, add_zero, zero_add, mul_one, MvPolynomial.smul_monomial]
    rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le hv]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl ht, ← Finset.sum_smul]
  have hc : (∑ i ∈ ν.support, (ν i:ℚ)*((n:ℚ)-2*i.val)) = (n:ℚ)*deg ν-2*weight ν := by
    simp only [deg, weight, Finsupp.sum, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_mul,
      Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  rw [hc, smul_comm, MvPolynomial.smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

theorem commutator (n k m : ℕ) {f : R n} (hf : f∈piece n k m) :
    D n (up n f)-up n (D n f)=((n*k:ℚ)-2*m) • f := by
  rw [← Derivation.commutator_apply, commutator_derivation]
  conv_rhs => rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum f]
  conv_lhs => rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum f]
  simp only [map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ν hν
  rw [Hder_monomial, (hf hν).1, (hf hν).2]


theorem inner_nonneg (n : ℕ) (f : R n) : 0 ≤ inner n f f := by
  by_cases hf : f=0
  · rw [hf,inner_zero_left]
  · exact (inner_pos n hf).le

theorem inner_neg_right (n : ℕ) (f g : R n) : inner n f (-g) = -inner n f g := by
  have h := inner_smul_right n (-1) f g
  simpa using h

theorem up_kernel_zero (n k m : ℕ) {f : R n} (hf : f∈piece n k m)
    (hm : 2*m<n*k) (hu : up n f=0) : f=0 := by
  by_contra hne
  have hc := commutator n k m hf
  rw [hu,map_zero,zero_sub] at hc
  have hi := congrArg (fun g => inner n f g) hc
  rw [inner_neg_right, inner_smul_right, ← adjoint] at hi
  have hp := inner_pos n hne
  have hn := inner_nonneg n (D n f)
  have hm' : 0<(n*k:ℚ)-2*m := by
    have hh : (2:ℚ)*m<n*k := by exact_mod_cast hm
    linarith
  nlinarith

theorem up_injOn_piece (n k m : ℕ) (hm : 2*m<n*k) :
    Set.InjOn (up n) (piece n k m) := by
  intro f hf g hg he
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply up_kernel_zero n k m ((piece n k m).sub_mem hf hg) hm
  rw [map_sub,he,sub_self]

end ChenJia
```

### `CJOperators.lean`

```lean
import CJCommutator

open MvPolynomial
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

theorem X_pderiv_piece {n k m : ℕ} (i j : Fin (n+1)) {f : R n}
    (hf : f∈piece n k m) : X i*pderiv j f ∈ piece n k (m+i.val-j.val) := by
  classical
  rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum f, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply (piece n k (m+i.val-j.val)).sum_mem
  intro ν hν
  rw [pderiv_monomial]
  by_cases hz : ν j=0
  · simp only [hz,Nat.cast_zero,mul_zero,monomial_zero,mul_zero]
    exact (piece _ _ _).zero_mem
  · have hle : Finsupp.single j 1≤ν := by rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff]; omega
    have hν' : ν-Finsupp.single j 1+Finsupp.single j 1=ν := tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle
    have hd := congrArg (@deg n) hν'
    have hw := congrArg (@weight n) hν'
    change deg (ν-Finsupp.single j 1+Finsupp.single j 1)=deg ν at hd
    change weight (ν-Finsupp.single j 1+Finsupp.single j 1)=weight ν at hw
    rw [deg_add, show deg (Finsupp.single j 1)=1 by simp [deg]] at hd
    rw [weight_add, show weight (Finsupp.single j 1)=j.val by simp [weight]] at hw
    obtain ⟨hdν,hwν⟩ := hf hν
    have hds : deg (ν-Finsupp.single j 1)+1=k := hd.trans hdν
    have hws : weight (ν-Finsupp.single j 1)+j.val=m := hw.trans hwν
    simp only [X, monomial_mul_monomial, one_mul]
    apply monomial_piece_of_degrees
    · rw [deg_add]
      have hi : deg (Finsupp.single i 1)=1 := by simp [deg]
      rw [hi]
      omega
    · rw [weight_add]
      have hi : weight (Finsupp.single i 1)=i.val := by simp [weight]
      rw [hi]
      omega

theorem D_piece {n k m : ℕ} {f : R n} (hf : f∈piece n k m) :
    D n f ∈ piece n k (m-1) := by
  rw [← downEdges_eq]
  simp only [downEdges, derivation_sum_apply, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  change (∑ i : Fin n, (i.val+1:ℚ) • (X i.castSucc*pderiv i.succ f)) ∈ piece n k (m-1)
  apply (piece _ _ _).sum_mem
  intro i _
  apply (piece _ _ _).smul_mem
  simpa only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ, show m+i.val-(i.val+1)=m-1 by omega] using
    X_pderiv_piece i.castSucc i.succ hf

theorem up_piece {n k m : ℕ} {f : R n} (hf : f∈piece n k m) :
    up n f ∈ piece n k (m+1) := by
  rw [← upEdges_eq]
  simp only [upEdges, derivation_sum_apply, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  change (∑ i : Fin n, ((n-i.val:ℕ):ℚ) • (X i.succ*pderiv i.castSucc f)) ∈ piece n k (m+1)
  apply (piece _ _ _).sum_mem
  intro i _
  apply (piece _ _ _).smul_mem
  simpa only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, show m+(i.val+1)-i.val=m+1 by omega] using
    X_pderiv_piece i.succ i.castSucc hf

def upMap (n k m : ℕ) : piece n k m →ₗ[ℚ] piece n k (m+1) :=
  ((up n).toLinearMap.domRestrict (piece n k m)).codRestrict (piece n k (m+1))
    (fun f => up_piece f.property)

def downMap (n k m : ℕ) (_hm : 1≤m) : piece n k m →ₗ[ℚ] piece n k (m-1) :=
  ((D n).toLinearMap.domRestrict (piece n k m)).codRestrict (piece n k (m-1))
    (fun f => D_piece f.property)

theorem up_injective (n k m : ℕ) (hm : 2*m<n*k) : Function.Injective (upMap n k m) := by
  intro f g hfg
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply up_injOn_piece n k m hm f.property g.property
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hfg

end ChenJia
```

### `CJDivision.lean`

```lean
import CJSupport
import CJOperators

open MvPolynomial
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

def diagonal (n : ℕ) (w : Fin (n+1) → ℚ) : Derivation ℚ (R n) (R n) :=
  mkDerivation ℚ (fun i => w i • X i)

theorem diagonal_monomial (n : ℕ) (w : Fin (n+1) → ℚ)
    (ν : Fin (n+1) →₀ ℕ) (a : ℚ) :
    diagonal n w (monomial ν a) = (ν.sum (fun i k => (k:ℚ)*w i)) • monomial ν a := by
  classical
  rw [diagonal, mkDerivation_monomial, Finsupp.sum]
  have ht (i : Fin (n+1)) (hi : i∈ν.support) :
      (monomial (ν-Finsupp.single i 1) (ν i:ℚ) : R n) • (w i • X i) =
        ((ν i:ℚ)*w i) • (monomial ν 1 : R n) := by
    have hv : Finsupp.single i 1≤ν := by
      rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff]
      have := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi
      omega
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_C_mul, C_apply, MvPolynomial.X,
      monomial_mul_monomial, zero_add, mul_one]
    rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le hv]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl ht, ← Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [smul_comm, MvPolynomial.smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rfl

theorem diagonal_coeff (n : ℕ) (w : Fin (n+1) → ℚ) (f : R n)
    (ν : Fin (n+1) →₀ ℕ) :
    (diagonal n w f).coeff ν=(ν.sum (fun i k => (k:ℚ)*w i))*f.coeff ν := by
  classical
  induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial μ a =>
    rw [diagonal_monomial, coeff_smul]
    simp only [coeff_monomial, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases h : μ=ν
    · subst μ; rfl
    · simp only [ite_eq_right h,mul_zero]
  | add f g hf hg =>
    rw [map_add]
    change ((diagonal n w f).coeff ν + (diagonal n w g).coeff ν) =
      (ν.sum (fun i k => (k:ℚ)*w i))*(f.coeff ν+g.coeff ν)
    rw [hf,hg,mul_add]

def degreeDeriv (n : ℕ) := diagonal n (fun _ => 1)
def weightDeriv (n : ℕ) := diagonal n (fun i => i.val)

theorem degreeDeriv_coeff (n : ℕ) (f : R n) (ν : Fin (n+1) →₀ ℕ) :
    (degreeDeriv n f).coeff ν=(deg ν:ℚ)*f.coeff ν := by
  rw [degreeDeriv,diagonal_coeff]
  simp only [deg,Finsupp.sum,Nat.cast_sum,mul_one]

theorem weightDeriv_coeff (n : ℕ) (f : R n) (ν : Fin (n+1) →₀ ℕ) :
    (weightDeriv n f).coeff ν=(weight ν:ℚ)*f.coeff ν := by
  rw [weightDeriv,diagonal_coeff]
  simp only [weight,Finsupp.sum,Nat.cast_sum,Nat.cast_mul]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

theorem piece_iff_euler (n k m : ℕ) (f : R n) :
    f∈piece n k m ↔ degreeDeriv n f=(k:ℚ) • f ∧ weightDeriv n f=(m:ℚ) • f := by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    constructor
    · ext ν
      rw [degreeDeriv_coeff,coeff_smul,smul_eq_mul]
      by_cases h : f.coeff ν=0
      · rw [h,mul_zero,mul_zero]
      · rw [(hf (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr h)).1]
    · ext ν
      rw [weightDeriv_coeff,coeff_smul,smul_eq_mul]
      by_cases h : f.coeff ν=0
      · rw [h,mul_zero,mul_zero]
      · rw [(hf (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr h)).2]
  · rintro ⟨hd,hw⟩ ν hν
    have hne := MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hν
    have hd' := congrArg (fun p : R n => p.coeff ν) hd
    have hw' := congrArg (fun p : R n => p.coeff ν) hw
    rw [degreeDeriv_coeff,coeff_smul,smul_eq_mul] at hd'
    rw [weightDeriv_coeff,coeff_smul,smul_eq_mul] at hw'
    exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast mul_right_cancel₀ hne hd', by exact_mod_cast mul_right_cancel₀ hne hw'⟩

theorem euler_div {n : ℕ} (δ : Derivation ℚ (R n) (R n)) (a b : ℚ)
    (hq : Q n≠0) (hδq : δ (Q n)=a • Q n) {f g : R n}
    (hδf : δ f=b • f) (hfg : f=Q n*g) : δ g=(b-a) • g := by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hq
  calc
    _ = δ (Q n*g)-g*(a • Q n) := by
      rw [Derivation.leibniz,hδq]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    _ = b • (Q n*g)-g*(a • Q n) := by rw [← hfg,hδf]
    _ = Q n*((b-a) • g) := by
      simp only [smul_eq_C_mul,map_sub]
      ring

theorem piece_div_Q {n k m : ℕ} (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n)
    (hk : 2≤k) (hm : n≤m) {f g : R n}
    (hf : f∈piece n k m) (hfg : f=Q n*g) : g∈piece n (k-2) (m-n) := by
  have hf' := (piece_iff_euler n k m f).mp hf
  have hq' := (piece_iff_euler n 2 n (Q n)).mp (Q_mem n)
  apply (piece_iff_euler n (k-2) (m-n) g).mpr
  constructor
  · rw [Nat.cast_sub hk]
    exact euler_div (degreeDeriv n) 2 k (Q_prime n hn he).ne_zero hq'.1 hf'.1 hfg
  · rw [Nat.cast_sub hm]
    exact euler_div (weightDeriv n) n m (Q_prime n hn he).ne_zero hq'.2 hf'.2 hfg

theorem Q_not_dvd_low_weight {n k m : ℕ} (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n)
    {f : R n} (hf : f∈piece n k m) (hf0 : f≠0) (hm : m<n) : ¬Q n∣f := by
  intro ⟨g,hfg⟩
  have hg : g≠0 := by intro h; rw [h,mul_zero] at hfg; exact hf0 hfg
  have hδf := ((piece_iff_euler n k m f).mp hf).2
  have hδq := ((piece_iff_euler n 2 n (Q n)).mp (Q_mem n)).2
  have ht := euler_div (weightDeriv n) n m (Q_prime n hn he).ne_zero hδq hδf hfg
  obtain ⟨ν,hν⟩ := MvPolynomial.support_nonempty.mpr hg
  have hne := MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hν
  have hh := congrArg (fun p : R n => p.coeff ν) ht
  rw [weightDeriv_coeff,coeff_smul,smul_eq_mul] at hh
  have hh' := mul_right_cancel₀ hne hh
  have hpos : (0:ℚ)≤weight ν := by positivity
  have hlt : (m:ℚ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hm
  linarith

end ChenJia
```

### `CJSylvester.lean`

```lean
import CJOperators
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForm.Orthogonal

open Module MvPolynomial
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

def pieceForm (n k m : ℕ) : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ (piece n k m) :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ ℚ (fun f g => inner n f.val g.val)
    (fun f g h => inner_add_left n f.val g.val h.val)
    (fun c f g => inner_smul_left n c f.val g.val)
    (fun f g h => inner_add_right n f.val g.val h.val)
    (fun c f g => inner_smul_right n c f.val g.val)

theorem pieceForm_ker (n k m : ℕ) : (pieceForm n k m).ker=⊥ := by
  apply (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mpr
  intro f hf
  apply Subtype.ext
  change f.val=0
  by_contra hn
  have h := congrArg (fun l => l f) (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hf)
  change inner n f.val f.val=0 at h
  exact (inner_pos n hn).ne' h

theorem down_surjective (n k m : ℕ) (hm : 1≤m) (hc : 2*m≤n*k) :
    Function.Surjective (downMap n k m hm) := by
  classical
  let b := pieceForm n k (m-1)
  let W := LinearMap.range (downMap n k m hm)
  have hp : b.orthogonal W=⊥ := by
    apply (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mpr
    intro g hg
    have hmem : up n g.val∈piece n k m := by
      simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hm] using up_piece g.property
    let ug : piece n k m := ⟨up n g.val,hmem⟩
    have ht := hg (downMap n k m hm ug) (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ ug)
    change inner n (D n (up n g.val)) g.val=0 at ht
    rw [adjoint] at ht
    have hz : up n g.val=0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact (inner_pos n hne).ne' ht
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply up_kernel_zero n k (m-1) g.property (by omega) hz
  have hd := b.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal' W
  rw [hp, pieceForm_ker, inf_bot_eq] at hd
  simp only [finrank_bot, Nat.add_zero] at hd
  apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
  apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
  exact hd


def semiKerEquiv (n k m : ℕ) (hm : 1≤m) :
    semi n k m ≃ₗ[ℚ] LinearMap.ker (downMap n k m hm) where
  toFun f := ⟨⟨f.val,f.property.1⟩, by
    apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact f.property.2⟩
  invFun f := ⟨f.val.val, f.val.property, by
    have h := congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp f.property)
    exact h⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

theorem sylvester_pos (n k m : ℕ) (hm : 1≤m) (hc : 2*m≤n*k) :
    (finrank ℚ (semi n k m):ℤ) = (gauss n k).coeff m-(gauss n k).coeff (m-1) := by
  have hd := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (downMap n k m hm)
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (down_surjective n k m hm hc), finrank_top] at hd
  have he := LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (semiKerEquiv n k m hm)
  rw [← he] at hd
  rw [← finrank_piece n k m, ← finrank_piece n k (m-1)]
  omega

theorem pderiv_weight_zero {n k : ℕ} {f : R n} (hf : f∈piece n k 0)
    (j : Fin (n+1)) (hj : 0<j.val) : pderiv j f=0 := by
  classical
  rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum f, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro ν hν
  have hw : weight ν=0 := (hf hν).2
  have hz : ν j=0 := by
    by_cases hs : j∈ν.support
    · have ht := Finset.single_le_sum (fun i (_hi : i∈ν.support) => Nat.zero_le (i.val*ν i)) hs
      change j.val*ν j≤weight ν at ht
      rw [hw] at ht
      nlinarith
    · exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hs
  simp only [pderiv_monomial, hz, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, monomial_zero]

theorem D_weight_zero {n k : ℕ} {f : R n} (hf : f∈piece n k 0) : D n f=0 := by
  rw [← downEdges_eq]
  simp only [downEdges,derivation_sum_apply,Derivation.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  rw [pderiv_weight_zero hf i.succ (by simp)]
  simp

theorem semi_zero (n k : ℕ) : semi n k 0=piece n k 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm inf_le_left
  intro f hf
  exact ⟨hf,D_weight_zero hf⟩

theorem sylvester (n k m : ℕ) (hc : 2*m≤n*k) :
    (finrank ℚ (semi n k m):ℤ) =
      (gauss n k).coeff m-(if m=0 then 0 else (gauss n k).coeff (m-1)) := by
  by_cases hm : m=0
  · subst m
    rw [semi_zero,finrank_piece]
    simp
  · rw [ite_eq_right hm]
    exact sylvester_pos n k m (by omega) hc

end ChenJia
```

### `CJSymmetry.lean`

```lean
import CJBridge
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Rev

open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

theorem wt_le {n k : ℕ} (v : Fin k → Fin (n+1)) : wt v ≤ n*k := by
  calc
    wt v ≤ ∑ _i : Fin k, n := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.le_of_lt_succ (v i).isLt)
    _ = n*k := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]

def boxComplement (n k : ℕ) : BoxPart n k ≃ BoxPart n k where
  toFun v := ⟨fun i => Fin.rev (v.val (Fin.rev i)), by
    intro i j hij
    exact Fin.rev_le_rev.mpr (v.property (Fin.rev_le_rev.mpr hij))⟩
  invFun v := ⟨fun i => Fin.rev (v.val (Fin.rev i)), by
    intro i j hij
    exact Fin.rev_le_rev.mpr (v.property (Fin.rev_le_rev.mpr hij))⟩
  left_inv v := by apply Subtype.ext; funext i; simp
  right_inv v := by apply Subtype.ext; funext i; simp

theorem wt_complement (n k : ℕ) (v : BoxPart n k) :
    wt (boxComplement n k v).val = n*k-wt v.val := by
  have hs : (∑ i : Fin k, (v.val (Fin.rev i)).val) = wt v.val :=
    Fintype.sum_equiv Fin.revPerm (fun i => (v.val (Fin.rev i)).val)
      (fun i => (v.val i).val) (fun _ => rfl)
  change (∑ i : Fin k, ((n+1) - ((v.val (Fin.rev i)).val+1))) = _
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_add_right]
  rw [Finset.sum_tsub_distrib Finset.univ (fun i _ => Nat.le_of_lt_succ (v.val (Fin.rev i)).isLt), hs]
  simp [Nat.mul_comm]

theorem coeff_gauss_eq_box_card (n k m : ℕ) :
    (gauss n k).coeff m = (Fintype.card {v : BoxPart n k // wt v.val=m} : ℤ) := by
  classical
  rw [coeff_gauss_eq_exp_card, Fintype.card_congr (boxWeightEquiv n k m)]

theorem gauss_symmetry (n k j : ℕ) (hj : j≤n*k) :
    (gauss n k).coeff j = (gauss n k).coeff (n*k-j) := by
  classical
  rw [coeff_gauss_eq_box_card, coeff_gauss_eq_box_card]
  congr 1
  apply Fintype.card_congr
  apply (boxComplement n k).subtypeEquiv
  intro v
  rw [wt_complement]
  constructor
  · intro hv; rw [hv]
  · intro hv
    have hw := wt_le v.val
    omega

end ChenJia
```

### `CJEndpoints.lean`

```lean
import CJProduct
import CJSymmetry
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.BigOperators
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Degree.Lemmas

open Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

theorem gauss_coeff_zero (n k : ℕ) : (gauss n k).coeff 0=1 := by
  have he := congrArg (constantCoeff : Polynomial ℤ →+* ℤ) (gauss_product_range n k)
  have hd : constantCoeff (denominator k)=1 := by
    rw [denominator, map_prod]
    simp
  have hp : constantCoeff (numerator n k)=1 := by
    rw [numerator, map_prod]
    simp
  rw [map_mul, hd, hp, mul_one] at he
  exact he

theorem gauss_natDegree_le (n k : ℕ) : (gauss n k).natDegree ≤ n*k := by
  apply natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
  intro v _
  simpa using wt_le v

theorem gauss_coeff_top (n k : ℕ) : (gauss n k).coeff (n*k)=1 := by
  simpa [gauss_coeff_zero] using (gauss_symmetry n k 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).symm

theorem gauss_natDegree (n k : ℕ) : (gauss n k).natDegree=n*k :=
  natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero (gauss_natDegree_le n k)
    (by rw [gauss_coeff_top]; decide)

theorem gauss_coeff_above (n k j : ℕ) (hj : n*k<j) : (gauss n k).coeff j=0 :=
  coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by rw [gauss_natDegree]; exact hj)

theorem gauss_coeff_one (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (hk : 0<k) : (gauss n k).coeff 1=1 := by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨k,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : k≠0)
    rw [gauss_pascal, coeff_add, coeff_X_pow_mul']
    cases n with
    | zero => norm_num [gauss_zero_left, gauss_coeff_zero, Polynomial.coeff_one]
    | succ n => simpa using ih k.succ (by omega) (by omega)

theorem F_ends (n k : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (hk : 2≤k) :
    (F n k).coeff 0=1 ∧ (F n k).coeff 1=1 := by
  simp [F, coeff_X_pow_mul', gauss_coeff_zero, gauss_coeff_one n k (by omega) (by omega),
    show ¬n≤1 by omega, show 0≠n by omega]

theorem F_degree (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (hk : 2≤k) : (F n k).natDegree=n*k := by
  have he : (F n k).coeff (n*k)=1 := by
    rw [F, coeff_sub, gauss_coeff_top, coeff_X_pow_mul']
    have hm : n*(k-2)<n*k-n := by
      have hmul := Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib n k 2
      have hkn : 2*n≤n*k := by nlinarith
      omega
    simp [show n≤n*k by nlinarith, gauss_coeff_above n (k-2) (n*k-n) hm]
  apply natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero _ (by rw [he]; decide)
  apply le_trans (natDegree_sub_le _ _) (max_le (gauss_natDegree_le n k) ?_)
  apply le_trans natDegree_mul_le
  rw [natDegree_X_pow, gauss_natDegree]
  have heq := Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib n k 2
  have hkn := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n hk
  omega

theorem shifted_gauss_symmetry (n k j : ℕ) (hk : 2≤k) (hj : j≤n*k) :
    (X^n * gauss n (k-2)).coeff j = (X^n * gauss n (k-2)).coeff (n*k-j) := by
  have hM : n*(k-2)+2*n=n*k := by
    calc
      n*(k-2)+2*n = n*((k-2)+2) := by ring
      _ = n*k := by congr 1; omega
  simp only [coeff_X_pow_mul']
  by_cases h₁ : n≤j <;> by_cases h₂ : n≤n*k-j
  · simp only [ite_eq_left h₁, ite_eq_left h₂]
    have hm : j-n≤n*(k-2) := by omega
    have he : n*k-j-n=n*(k-2)-(j-n) := by omega
    rw [he]
    exact gauss_symmetry n (k-2) (j-n) hm
  · simp only [ite_eq_left h₁, ite_eq_right h₂]
    apply gauss_coeff_above
    omega
  · simp only [ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_left h₂]
    symm
    apply gauss_coeff_above
    omega
  · simp only [ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_right h₂]

theorem F_symmetry (n k j : ℕ) (hk : 2≤k) (hj : j≤n*k) :
    (F n k).coeff j=(F n k).coeff (n*k-j) := by
  simp only [F, coeff_sub]
  rw [gauss_symmetry n k j hj, shifted_gauss_symmetry n k j hk hj]

theorem endpoint_structural (n k : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (hk : 15≤k) :
    (F n k).natDegree=n*k ∧
    (∀ j≤n*k, (F n k).coeff j=(F n k).coeff (n*k-j)) ∧
    (F n k).coeff 0=(F n k).coeff 1 := by
  exact ⟨F_degree n k (by omega) (by omega),
    fun j hj => F_symmetry n k j (by omega) hj,
    (F_ends n k (by omega) (by omega)).1.trans (F_ends n k (by omega) (by omega)).2.symm⟩

end ChenJia
```

```lean
import CJDivision
import CJSylvester
import CJEndpoints

open Module
noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

instance semiFinite (n k m : ℕ) : Module.Finite ℚ (semi n k m) :=
  Module.Finite.of_injective (Submodule.inclusion (show semi n k m≤piece n k m from inf_le_left))
    (Submodule.inclusion_injective _)

def mulQMap (n k m : ℕ) (hk : 2≤k) (hm : n≤m) :
    semi n (k-2) (m-n) →ₗ[ℚ] semi n k m where
  toFun f := ⟨Q n*f.val, by
    constructor
    · change Q n*f.val∈piece n k m
      have h := piece_mul (Q_mem n) f.property.1
      simpa only [Nat.add_sub_of_le hk,Nat.add_sub_of_le hm] using h
    · change D n (Q n*f.val)=0
      rw [Derivation.leibniz,D_Q_all,show D n f.val=0 from f.property.2]
      simp⟩
  map_add' f g := by apply Subtype.ext; exact mul_add _ _ _
  map_smul' c f := by apply Subtype.ext; exact mul_smul_comm _ _ _

theorem mulQMap_injective (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n) (hk : 2≤k) (hm : n≤m) :
    Function.Injective (mulQMap n k m hk hm) := by
  intro f g hfg
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Q_prime n hn he).ne_zero (congrArg Subtype.val hfg)

theorem mulQMap_range (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n) (hk : 2≤k) (hm : n≤m)
    (f : semi n k m) : f∈LinearMap.range (mulQMap n k m hk hm) ↔ Q n∣f.val := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g.val,rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨g,hfg⟩
    refine ⟨⟨g, piece_div_Q hn he hk hm f.property.1 hfg, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact semi_div_Q n hn he f.property.2 hfg
    · exact Subtype.ext hfg.symm

theorem nonzeroClass_iff_range_ne_top (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n)
    (hk : 2≤k) (hm : n≤m) : NonzeroClass n k m ↔
      LinearMap.range (mulQMap n k m hk hm)≠⊤ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f,hfp,hfD,hfQ⟩ htop
    let fs : semi n k m := ⟨f,hfp,hfD⟩
    have hr : fs∈LinearMap.range (mulQMap n k m hk hm) := by rw [htop]; trivial
    exact hfQ ((mulQMap_range n k m hn he hk hm fs).mp hr)
  · intro hne
    by_contra hno
    apply hne
    apply top_unique
    intro f _
    apply (mulQMap_range n k m hn he hk hm f).mpr
    by_contra hnot
    exact hno ⟨f.val,f.property.1,f.property.2,hnot⟩

theorem nonzeroClass_iff_dimension (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n)
    (hk : 2≤k) (hm : n≤m) : NonzeroClass n k m ↔
      finrank ℚ (semi n (k-2) (m-n))<finrank ℚ (semi n k m) := by
  rw [nonzeroClass_iff_range_ne_top n k m hn he hk hm]
  have hd := LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (mulQMap_injective n k m hn he hk hm)
  rw [← hd]
  constructor
  · intro hne
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne (Submodule.finrank_le _)
    intro heq
    exact hne (Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq heq)
  · intro hlt htop
    rw [htop,finrank_top] at hlt
    exact (lt_irrefl _ hlt)

end ChenJia
```

### `CJDimensionH.lean`

```lean
import CJQuotient

open Module
noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

theorem h_expanded (n k m : ℕ) (hm : 1≤m) :
    h n k m = (gauss n k).coeff m-(gauss n k).coeff (m-1) -
      (if n≤m then (gauss n (k-2)).coeff (m-n) else 0) +
      (if n≤m-1 then (gauss n (k-2)).coeff (m-1-n) else 0) := by
  rw [h_eq_diff n k m hm]
  simp only [F,Polynomial.coeff_sub,Polynomial.coeff_X_pow_mul']
  ring

theorem h_dimension_difference (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (hk : 2≤k)
    (hm : n≤m) (hc : 2*m≤n*k) :
    h n k m = (finrank ℚ (semi n k m):ℤ) - (finrank ℚ (semi n (k-2) (m-n)):ℤ) := by
  have hl : 2*(m-n)≤n*(k-2) := by
    have hk' := Nat.sub_add_cancel hk
    have hm' := Nat.sub_add_cancel hm
    nlinarith
  rw [sylvester n k m hc,sylvester n (k-2) (m-n) hl,h_expanded n k m (by omega)]
  rw [ite_eq_right (by omega : m≠0),ite_eq_left hm]
  by_cases he : m=n
  · subst m
    simp only [Nat.sub_self,ite_true,ite_eq_right (by omega : ¬n≤n-1)]
    ring
  · rw [ite_eq_right (by omega : m-n≠0),ite_eq_left (by omega : n≤m-1)]
    rw [show m-1-n=m-n-1 by omega]
    ring

theorem h_dimension_low (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (hm : m<n) (hc : 2*m≤n*k) :
    h n k m = (finrank ℚ (semi n k m):ℤ) := by
  rw [sylvester n k m hc]
  by_cases he : m=0
  · subst m
    simp [h,F,gauss_coeff_zero,show (0:ℕ)≠n by omega]
  · rw [h_expanded n k m (by omega),ite_eq_right (by omega : ¬n≤m),
      ite_eq_right (by omega : ¬n≤m-1),ite_eq_right he]
    ring

theorem nonzeroClass_low_iff_dimension (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n) (hm : m<n) :
    NonzeroClass n k m ↔ 0<finrank ℚ (semi n k m) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f,hfp,hfD,hfQ⟩
    have hf0 : f≠0 := by intro h; exact hfQ (h ▸ dvd_zero _)
    have hfs : (⟨f,hfp,hfD⟩ : semi n k m)≠0 := by intro h; exact hf0 (congrArg Subtype.val h)
    have : Nontrivial (semi n k m) := nontrivial_of_ne _ _ hfs
    exact Module.finrank_pos
  · intro hd
    have := Module.finrank_pos_iff.mp hd
    obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := exists_ne (0 : semi n k m)
    have hf0 : f.val≠0 := by intro h; exact hf (Subtype.ext h)
    exact ⟨f.val,f.property.1,f.property.2,Q_not_dvd_low_weight hn he f.property.1 hf0 hm⟩

theorem nonzeroClass_iff_h_pos (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n)
    (hk : 2≤k) (hc : 2*m≤n*k) : NonzeroClass n k m ↔ 0<h n k m := by
  by_cases hm : n≤m
  · rw [nonzeroClass_iff_dimension n k m hn he hk hm,h_dimension_difference n k m hn hk hm hc]
    omega
  · rw [nonzeroClass_low_iff_dimension n k m hn he (by omega),
      h_dimension_low n k m hn (by omega) hc]
    omega

end ChenJia
```

### `CJIntervalCover.lean`

```lean
import CJSemigroups
import CJDimensionH

namespace ChenJia

def CentralSupport (n c : ℕ) : Prop := NonzeroClass n c (c*(n/2))

theorem even_half_mul (n c : ℕ) (he : Even n) : n*c/2=c*(n/2) := by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := he
  have ha : (a+a)/2=a := by omega
  rw [ha]
  have hh : (a+a)*c=c*a*2 := by ring
  rw [hh, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ (by decide)]

theorem interval_cover_half (a k m : ℕ) (ha : 4≤a) (hk : 15≤k)
    (hm : 2≤m ∧ m≤k*a) :
    ∃ c, c≤k-6 ∧ (c=0 ∨ c=4 ∨ 8≤c) ∧ c*a+2≤m ∧ m≤c*a+6*a := by
  by_cases h0 : m≤6*a
  · exact ⟨0,by omega,Or.inl rfl,by omega,by simpa using h0⟩
  by_cases h4 : m≤10*a
  · refine ⟨4,by omega,Or.inr (Or.inl rfl),?_,?_⟩ <;> omega
  let d := (m-2)/a
  have hda : d*a≤m-2 := Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
  have hrem : m-2< (d+1)*a := by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (m-2) (show 0<a by omega)
  have hm2 : m-2+2=m := by omega
  have hd : 8≤d := by
    by_contra hh
    have hle := Nat.mul_le_mul_right a (show d+1≤8 by omega)
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨min (k-6) d, min_le_left _ _,Or.inr (Or.inr (le_min (by omega) hd)),?_,?_⟩
  · have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right a (min_le_right (k-6) d)
    omega
  · by_cases hh : k-6≤d
    · rw [min_eq_left hh]
      have heq : (k-6)*a+6*a=k*a := by
        rw [← Nat.add_mul, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
      rw [heq]
      exact hm.2
    · rw [min_eq_right (by omega)]
      nlinarith [hm2]

theorem interval_cover (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (he : Even n) (hk : 15≤k)
    (hm : 2≤m ∧ m≤n*k/2) (hs : ∀ c, 8≤c → CentralSupport n c)
    (hs0 : CentralSupport n 0) (hs4 : CentralSupport n 4) :
    ∃ c, c≤k-6 ∧ CentralSupport n c ∧ c*n/2+2≤m ∧ m≤c*n/2+3*n := by
  have hn2 : n=2*(n/2) := by obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := he; omega
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hcs,hl,hu⟩ := interval_cover_half (n/2) k m (by omega) hk
    ⟨hm.1,by rw [← even_half_mul n k he]; exact hm.2⟩
  have hs' : CentralSupport n c := by
    rcases hcs with rfl | rfl | hh
    · exact hs0
    · exact hs4
    · exact hs c hh
  refine ⟨c,hc,hs',?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [Nat.mul_comm c n,even_half_mul n c he] using hl
  · rw [Nat.mul_comm c n,even_half_mul n c he]
    nlinarith

end ChenJia
```

### `CJPropagation.lean`

```lean
import CJIntervalCover
import CJSupport

namespace ChenJia

theorem central_zero (n : ℕ) : CentralSupport n 0 := by
  simpa [CentralSupport] using nonzeroClass_zero n

theorem central_add (n c d : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n)
    (hc : CentralSupport n c) (hd : CentralSupport n d) : CentralSupport n (c+d) := by
  simpa [CentralSupport,Nat.add_mul] using nonzeroClass_add hn he hc hd

theorem central_multiple (n c a : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n)
    (hc : CentralSupport n c) : CentralSupport n (c*a) := by
  induction a with
  | zero => simpa using central_zero n
  | succ a ih =>
    simpa [Nat.mul_succ] using central_add n (c*a) c hn he ih hc

theorem central34_of_generators (n c : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n)
    (h3 : CentralSupport n 3) (h4 : CentralSupport n 4) (hc : S34 c) : CentralSupport n c := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,rfl⟩ := hc
  exact central_add n _ _ hn he (central_multiple n 3 a hn he h3) (central_multiple n 4 b hn he h4)

theorem central456_of_generators (n c : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (he : Even n)
    (h4 : CentralSupport n 4) (h5 : CentralSupport n 5) (h6 : CentralSupport n 6)
    (hc : S456 c) : CentralSupport n c := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,d,rfl⟩ := hc
  exact central_add n _ _ hn he
    (central_add n _ _ hn he (central_multiple n 4 a hn he h4) (central_multiple n 5 b hn he h5))
    (central_multiple n 6 d hn he h6)

theorem strict_of_central_support
    (seed : ∀ n m : ℕ, 8≤n → Even n → 2≤m → m≤3*n → 0<h n 6 m)
    (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (he : Even n) (hk : 15≤k)
    (hm : 2≤m ∧ m≤n*k/2) (hs : ∀ c, 8≤c → CentralSupport n c)
    (hs4 : CentralSupport n 4) : 0<h n k m := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hcs,hl,hu⟩ := interval_cover n k m hn he hk hm hs (central_zero n) hs4
  have hlow : 2≤m-c*n/2 := by omega
  have hhigh : m-c*n/2≤3*n := by omega
  have hseed := (nonzeroClass_iff_h_pos n 6 (m-c*n/2) (by omega) he (by decide)
    (by omega)).mpr (seed n (m-c*n/2) hn he hlow hhigh)
  have hs' := nonzeroClass_add (by omega : 2≤n) he hcs hseed
  have hpad := nonzeroClass_pad (l:=k-(c+6)) (by omega : 2≤n) he hs'
  apply (nonzeroClass_iff_h_pos n k m (by omega) he (by omega) (by omega)).mp
  have hdeg : c+6+(k-(c+6))=k := by omega
  have hweight : c*(n/2)+(m-c*n/2)=m := by
    rw [Nat.mul_comm c n,even_half_mul n c he] at hl ⊢
    omega
  rwa [hdeg,hweight] at hpad

end ChenJia
```

### `CJCentralSupport.lean`

```lean
import CJCentralSeeds
import CJPropagation

namespace ChenJia

theorem central_four (n : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (he : Even n) : CentralSupport n 4 := by
  have hh := L4 n hn he
  have hp : 0<h n 4 (2*n) := by
    rw [hh]
    have hpos : 0<n/6 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast hpos
  have hm : 4*(n/2)=2*n := by obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := he; omega
  rw [CentralSupport,hm]
  exact (nonzeroClass_iff_h_pos n 4 (2*n) (by omega) he (by decide) (by omega)).mpr hp

theorem central_three (n : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (he : 4∣n) : CentralSupport n 3 := by
  have hev : Even n := by obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := he; exact ⟨2*a,by omega⟩
  rw [CentralSupport,← even_half_mul n 3 hev]
  exact (nonzeroClass_iff_h_pos n 3 (n*3/2) (by omega) hev (by decide)
    (by omega)).mpr (by rw [Nat.mul_comm n 3,L3 n hn he]; decide)

theorem central_five (n : ℕ) (hn : 18≤n) (he : n%4=2) : CentralSupport n 5 := by
  have hev : Even n := by exact ⟨n/2,by omega⟩
  rw [CentralSupport,← even_half_mul n 5 hev]
  exact (nonzeroClass_iff_h_pos n 5 (n*5/2) (by omega) hev (by decide)
    (by omega)).mpr (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm n 5] using L5 n hn he)

theorem central34 (n c : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (he : 4∣n) (hc : S34 c) : CentralSupport n c := by
  have hev : Even n := by obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := he; exact ⟨2*a,by omega⟩
  exact central34_of_generators n c (by omega) hev (central_three n hn he) (central_four n hn hev) hc

theorem central456_of_L6
    (seed : ∀ n m : ℕ, 8≤n → Even n → 2≤m → m≤3*n → 0<h n 6 m)
    (n c : ℕ) (hn : 18≤n) (he : n%4=2) (hc : S456 c) : CentralSupport n c := by
  have hev : Even n := by exact ⟨n/2,by omega⟩
  have hm : 6*(n/2)=3*n := by obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := hev; omega
  have h6 : CentralSupport n 6 := by
    rw [CentralSupport,hm]
    exact (nonzeroClass_iff_h_pos n 6 (3*n) (by omega) hev (by decide) (by omega)).mpr
      (seed n (3*n) (by omega) hev (by omega) (by omega))
  exact central456_of_generators n c (by omega) hev (central_four n (by omega) hev) (central_five n hn he) h6 hc

end ChenJia
```

```lean
  norm_num [quarticEval,quarticTable,newtonEval,dataCJCompactSample_3240,binomEval,falling,Nat.factorial]
  ring
theorem positiveCJCompactSample_3240 (u v : ℕ) : 0<casePoly 2 46 56 0 0 u v :=
  certified_positive dataCJCompactSample_3240 _ identityCJCompactSample_3240 signsCJCompactSample_3240 u v
theorem literalPositiveCJCompactSample_3240 (u v : ℕ) : 0<h (60*(0+u)+46+(60*(0+v)+56)) 6 (3*(60*(0+u)+46)+2*(60*(0+v)+56)) := by
  have hp := positiveCJCompactSample_3240 u v
  rw [← casePoly_literal 2 46 56 0 0 u v (by omega)] at hp
  norm_num only at hp
  exact_mod_cast hp

end ChenJia
```

### `CJExceptionalInduction.lean`

```lean
import CJPropagation

namespace ChenJia

theorem exceptional_induction (n : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (he : Even n)
    (h4 : CentralSupport n 4)
    (seeds : ∀ k m : ℕ, 15≤k ∧ k≤18 → 2≤m ∧ m≤n*k/2 → 0<h n k m) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, 15≤k → ∀ m : ℕ, 2≤m ∧ m≤n*k/2 → 0<h n k m := by
  have hn2 : n=2*(n/2) := by obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := he; omega
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
    intro hk m hm
    by_cases hb : k≤18
    · exact seeds k m ⟨hk,hb⟩ hm
    have h19 : 19≤k := by omega
    apply (nonzeroClass_iff_h_pos n k m (by omega) he (by omega) (by omega)).mp
    by_cases hl : m≤n*(k-1)/2
    · have hp := ih (k-1) (by omega) (by omega) m ⟨hm.1,hl⟩
      have hc := (nonzeroClass_iff_h_pos n (k-1) m (by omega) he (by omega) (by omega)).mpr hp
      have hh := nonzeroClass_pad (l:=1) (by omega : 2≤n) he hc
      simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel (show 1≤k by omega)] using hh
    · have hprev : n*(k-1)/2=(k-1)*(n/2) := even_half_mul n (k-1) he
      have htop : n*k/2=k*(n/2) := even_half_mul n k he
      have hnext : n*(k-4)/2=(k-4)*(n/2) := even_half_mul n (k-4) he
      have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n/2) (show 18≤k-1 by omega)
      have heq : (k-4)*(n/2)+4*(n/2)=k*(n/2) := by
        rw [← Nat.add_mul,Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
      have hlo : 2≤m-4*(n/2) := by rw [hprev] at hl; omega
      have hmTop : m≤k*(n/2) := by rw [← htop]; exact hm.2
      have hup : m-4*(n/2)≤n*(k-4)/2 := by rw [hnext]; omega
      have hp := ih (k-4) (by omega) (by omega) (m-4*(n/2)) ⟨hlo,hup⟩
      have hc := (nonzeroClass_iff_h_pos n (k-4) (m-4*(n/2)) (by omega) he
        (by omega) (by omega)).mpr hp
      have hh := nonzeroClass_add (by omega : 2≤n) he h4 hc
      have hdeg : 4+(k-4)=k := by omega
      have hw : 4*(n/2)+(m-4*(n/2))=m := by omega
      rwa [hdeg,hw] at hh

end ChenJia
```

### `CJGaussianStep.lean`

```lean
import CJProduct
import CJPolyLists

noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

theorem gauss_table_left (k : ℕ) : gauss 0 k=listPoly [1] := by
  rw [gauss_zero_left]
  simp [listPoly]

theorem gauss_table_right (n : ℕ) : gauss n 0=listPoly [1] := by
  rw [gauss_zero_right]
  simp [listPoly]

theorem gauss_table_step (n k : ℕ) (a b c : List ℤ)
    (ha : gauss n (k+1)=listPoly a) (hb : gauss (n+1) k=listPoly b)
    (hc : c=polyAdd a (List.replicate (n+1) 0 ++ b)) :
    gauss (n+1) (k+1)=listPoly c := by
  rw [gauss_pascal,ha,hb,hc,listPoly_add,listPoly_shift]

end ChenJia
```

### `CJTableTransfer.lean`

```lean
import CJPolyLists
import CJDefinitions

open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace ChenJia

theorem table_coeff (p : Polynomial ℤ) (a : List ℤ) (hp : p=listPoly a) (j : ℕ) :
    p.coeff j=a[j]?.getD 0 :=
  (congrArg (fun q : Polynomial ℤ => q.coeff j) hp).trans (coeff_listPoly a j)

theorem difference_table_coeff (p q : Polynomial ℤ) (a b : List ℤ)
    (hp : p=listPoly a) (hq : q=listPoly b) (r j : ℕ) :
    (p-X^r*q).coeff j = a[j]?.getD 0 - if r≤j then b[j-r]?.getD 0 else 0 := by
  rw [coeff_sub, coeff_X_pow_mul', table_coeff p a hp, table_coeff q b hq]

theorem F_table_coeff (n k : ℕ) (a b : List ℤ)
    (ha : gauss n k=listPoly a) (hb : gauss n (k-2)=listPoly b) (j : ℕ) :
    (F n k).coeff j=a[j]?.getD 0 - if n≤j then b[j-n]?.getD 0 else 0 :=
  difference_table_coeff (gauss n k) (gauss n (k-2)) a b ha hb n j

theorem difference_table_list (p q : Polynomial ℤ) (a b : List ℤ)
    (hp : p=listPoly a) (hq : q=listPoly b) (r : ℕ) (js : List ℕ) :
    js.map (fun j => (p-X^r*q).coeff j) =
      js.map (fun j => a[j]?.getD 0 - if r≤j then b[j-r]?.getD 0 else 0) :=
  congrArg (fun f : ℕ → ℤ => js.map f)
    (funext (difference_table_coeff p q a b hp hq r))

theorem h_table_coeff (n k : ℕ) (a b : List ℤ)
    (ha : gauss n k=listPoly a) (hb : gauss n (k-2)=listPoly b)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : 1≤j) :
    h n k j = (a[j]?.getD 0 - if n≤j then b[j-n]?.getD 0 else 0) -
      (a[j-1]?.getD 0 - if n≤j-1 then b[j-1-n]?.getD 0 else 0) :=
  (h_eq_diff n k j hj).trans
    (congrArg₂ (fun x y : ℤ => x-y) (F_table_coeff n k a b ha hb j)
      (F_table_coeff n k a b ha hb (j-1)))

end ChenJia
```

### `CJExceptionalSeeds.lean`

```lean
import CJSeedRow14
import CJTableTransfer
import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases

namespace ChenJia

theorem exceptionalSeed10_15 (m : ℕ) (hm : 2≤m) (hc : m≤75) : 0<h 10 15 m := by
  rw [h_table_coeff 10 15 seedG10_15 seedG10_13 seedGauss10_15 seedGauss10_13 m (by omega)]
  have hh : ∀ j : Fin 76, 2≤j.val →
      0<(seedG10_15[j.val]?.getD 0 - if 10≤j.val then seedG10_13[j.val-10]?.getD 0 else 0)-
        (seedG10_15[j.val-1]?.getD 0 - if 10≤j.val-1 then seedG10_13[j.val-1-10]?.getD 0 else 0) := by decide +kernel
  exact hh ⟨m,by omega⟩ hm

        (seedG10_16[j.val-1]?.getD 0 - if 10≤j.val-1 then seedG10_14[j.val-1-10]?.getD 0 else 0) := by decide +kernel
  exact hh ⟨m,by omega⟩ hm
```

### `CJResidueCover.lean`

```lean
import CJValidity

namespace ChenJia

theorem residue_cover (e x y : ℕ) (he : e=1 ∨ e=2) (hn : 8≤x+y)
    (hp : Even (x+y)) :
    ∃ r s bx by0 u v : ℕ, ValidCase e r s bx by0 ∧
      x=60*(bx+u)+r ∧ y=60*(by0+v)+s := by
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := hp
  have hr : x%60<60 := Nat.mod_lt x (by decide)
  have hs : y%60<60 := Nat.mod_lt y (by decide)
  have parity : (x%60+y%60)%2=0 := by omega
  by_cases hh : 8≤x%60+y%60
  · refine ⟨x%60,y%60,0,0,x/60,y/60,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · exact ⟨he,hr,hs,parity,by simp [hh]⟩
    · omega
    · omega
  · by_cases hx : 1≤x/60
    · refine ⟨x%60,y%60,1,0,x/60-1,y/60,?_,?_,?_⟩
      · exact ⟨he,hr,hs,parity,by simp [hh]⟩
      · omega
      · omega
    · refine ⟨x%60,y%60,0,1,x/60,y/60-1,?_,?_,?_⟩
      · exact ⟨he,hr,hs,parity,by simp [hh]⟩
      · omega
      · omega

end ChenJia
```

### `CJLowWeight.lean`

```lean
import CJRegions

open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false
namespace ChenJia

theorem series_mul_nonneg (a b : PowerSeries ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ m, 0≤a.coeff m) (hb : ∀ m, 0≤b.coeff m) (m : ℕ) :
    0≤(a*b).coeff m := by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ij _ => mul_nonneg (ha ij.1) (hb ij.2))

theorem series_mul_positive (a b : PowerSeries ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ m, 0≤a.coeff m) (hb : ∀ m, 0≤b.coeff m)
    (i j : ℕ) (hi : 0<a.coeff i) (hj : 0<b.coeff j) :
    0<(a*b).coeff (i+j) := by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hi hj)
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ij _ => mul_nonneg (ha ij.1) (hb ij.2))
      (show (i,j)∈Finset.antidiagonal (i+j) by simp))

theorem coinSeries_nonneg (ds : List ℕ) (m : ℕ) : 0≤(coinSeries ds).coeff m := by
  induction ds generalizing m with
  | nil => simp only [coinSeries, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, PowerSeries.coeff_one]; split <;> norm_num
  | cons d ds ih =>
    change 0≤(coinFactor d*coinSeries ds).coeff m
    apply series_mul_nonneg _ _ _ _ m
    · intro t; simp [coinFactor]; split <;> omega
    · exact ih

theorem coinSeries_zero_positive (ds : List ℕ) : 0<(coinSeries ds).coeff 0 := by
  induction ds with
  | nil => simp [coinSeries]
  | cons d ds ih =>
    change 0<(coinFactor d*coinSeries ds).coeff 0
    simpa using series_mul_positive (coinFactor d) (coinSeries ds)
      (fun t => by simp [coinFactor]; split <;> omega) (coinSeries_nonneg ds)
      0 0 (by simp [coinFactor]) ih

theorem restricted60_positive (m : ℕ) (hm : 2≤m) :
    0<restricted [2,3,4,5,6] m := by
  have hp : ∀ a b : ℕ, 0<(coinSeries [2,3,4,5,6]).coeff (2*a+3*b) := by
    intro a b
    have h3 : 0<(coinSeries [3,4,5,6]).coeff (3*b) := by
      have hh := series_mul_positive (coinFactor 3) (coinSeries [4,5,6])
        (fun t => by simp [coinFactor]; split <;> omega) (coinSeries_nonneg _)
        (3*b) 0 (by simp [coinFactor]) (coinSeries_zero_positive _)
      simpa [coinSeries] using hh
    have hh := series_mul_positive (coinFactor 2) (coinSeries [3,4,5,6])
      (fun t => by simp [coinFactor]; split <;> omega) (coinSeries_nonneg _)
      (2*a) (3*b) (by simp [coinFactor]) h3
    exact hh
  obtain ⟨a,b,he⟩ : ∃ a b : ℕ, m=2*a+3*b := by
    by_cases hh : m%2=0
    · exact ⟨m/2,0,by omega⟩
    · exact ⟨(m-3)/2,1,by omega⟩
  rw [restricted, ite_eq_left (by positivity)]
  simpa only [Int.toNat_natCast, he] using hp a b

theorem h6_low (n m : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (hm : m<n) :
    h n 6 m=restricted [2,3,4,5,6] m := by
  rw [h6_truncated n m hn (by omega)]
  have hv (a b : ℤ) (ha : 1≤a) (hb : 0≤b) :
      restricted [2,3,4,5,6] ((m:ℤ)-(a*n+b))=0 := by
    apply restricted_negative
    have : (m:ℤ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hm
    nlinarith [show (0:ℤ)≤n by positivity]
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at *
  simp only [hv 1 0 (by decide) (by decide), hv 1 1 (by decide) (by decide),
    hv 1 2 (by decide) (by decide), hv 1 3 (by decide) (by decide),
    hv 1 4 (by decide) (by decide), hv 1 11 (by decide) (by decide),
    hv 2 1 (by decide) (by decide), hv 2 2 (by decide) (by decide),
    hv 2 3 (by decide) (by decide), hv 2 4 (by decide) (by decide),
    hv 2 5 (by decide) (by decide), hv 2 6 (by decide) (by decide),
    hv 2 7 (by decide) (by decide), hv 2 11 (by decide) (by decide),
    hv 2 12 (by decide) (by decide), hv 2 13 (by decide) (by decide),
    hv 2 14 (by decide) (by decide), hv 2 15 (by decide) (by decide), sub_zero, add_zero]
  simp
  exact restricted_negative _ _ (by omega)

end ChenJia
```

### `CJL6Transfer.lean`

```lean
import CJResidueCover
import CJLowWeight

namespace ChenJia

theorem H_positive_of_cases
    (cert : ∀ e r s bx by0 : ℕ, ValidCase e r s bx by0 → ∀ u v : ℕ,
      0<casePoly e r s bx by0 u v)
    (e x y : ℕ) (he : e=1 ∨ e=2) (hn : 8≤x+y) (hp : Even (x+y)) :
    0<H e x y := by
  obtain ⟨r,s,bx,by0,u,v,hv,rfl,rfl⟩ := residue_cover e x y he hn hp
  have hh := cert e r s bx by0 hv u v
  rw [← H_residue] at hh
  exact_mod_cast hh

theorem L6_of_cases
    (cert : ∀ e r s bx by0 : ℕ, ValidCase e r s bx by0 → ∀ u v : ℕ,
      0<casePoly e r s bx by0 u v)
    (n m : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (he : Even n) (hm : 2≤m) (hc : m≤3*n) :
    0<h n 6 m := by
  by_cases hl : m<n
  · rw [h6_low n m hn hl]
    exact restricted60_positive m hm
  · rw [h6_regions n m hn ⟨by omega,hc⟩]
    by_cases hh : m≤2*n
    · rw [ite_eq_left hh]
      have hs : m-n+(2*n-m)=n := by omega
      exact H_positive_of_cases cert 1 (m-n) (2*n-m) (Or.inl rfl)
        (by omega) (by rw [hs]; exact he)
    · rw [ite_eq_right hh]
      have hs : m-2*n+(3*n-m)=n := by omega
      exact H_positive_of_cases cert 2 (m-2*n) (3*n-m) (Or.inr rfl)
        (by omega) (by rw [hs]; exact he)

end ChenJia
```

### `CJFinalTransfer.lean`

```lean
import CJCentralSupport
import CJExceptionalInduction
import CJExceptionalSeeds
import CJEndpoints

namespace ChenJia

theorem generic_strict_of_L6
    (seed : ∀ n m : ℕ, 8≤n → Even n → 2≤m → m≤3*n → 0<h n 6 m)
    (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (he : Even n) (hne : n≠10 ∧ n≠14)
    (hk : 15≤k) (hm : 2≤m ∧ m≤n*k/2) : 0<h n k m := by
  apply strict_of_central_support seed n k m hn he hk hm _ (central_four n hn he)
  intro c hc
  by_cases h4 : n%4=0
  · apply central34 n c hn (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h4)
    exact S34_tail c (by omega)
  · have hmod : n%4=2 := by obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := he; omega
    exact central456_of_L6 seed n c (by omega) hmod (S456_tail c hc)

theorem exceptional_strict (n k m : ℕ) (hn : n=10 ∨ n=14)
    (hk : 15≤k) (hm : 2≤m ∧ m≤n*k/2) : 0<h n k m := by
  have h8 : 8≤n := by rcases hn with rfl | rfl <;> omega
  have he : Even n := by rcases hn with rfl | rfl <;> decide
  exact exceptional_induction n h8 he (central_four n h8 he)
    (fun k m hk hm => exceptional_seeds n k m hn hk hm) k hk m hm

theorem full_strict_of_L6
    (seed : ∀ n m : ℕ, 8≤n → Even n → 2≤m → m≤3*n → 0<h n 6 m)
    (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (he : Even n) (hk : 15≤k)
    (hm : 2≤m ∧ m≤n*k/2) : 0<h n k m := by
  by_cases hh : n=10 ∨ n=14
  · exact exceptional_strict n k m hh hk hm
  · exact generic_strict_of_L6 seed n k m hn he (by omega) hk hm

end ChenJia
```

```lean
import CJL6
import CJFinalTransfer

namespace ChenJia

theorem central456 (n c : ℕ) (hn : 18≤n) (he : n%4=2) (hc : S456 c) : CentralSupport n c :=
  central456_of_L6 L6 n c hn he hc

theorem generic_strict (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (he : Even n)
    (hne : n≠10 ∧ n≠14) (hk : 15≤k) (hm : 2≤m ∧ m≤n*k/2) : 0<h n k m :=
  generic_strict_of_L6 L6 n k m hn he hne hk hm

theorem chen_jia_conj_3_3 (n k : ℕ) (hn : 8≤n) (he : Even n) (hk : 15≤k) :
    (F n k).natDegree=n*k ∧
    (∀ j≤n*k, (F n k).coeff j=(F n k).coeff (n*k-j)) ∧
    (F n k).coeff 0=(F n k).coeff 1 ∧
    (∀ m, 2≤m → m≤n*k/2 → (F n k).coeff (m-1)<(F n k).coeff m) := by
  obtain ⟨hd,hs,heq⟩ := endpoint_structural n k hn hk
  refine ⟨hd,hs,heq,?_⟩
  intro m hm hc
  have hp := full_strict_of_L6 L6 n k m hn he hk ⟨hm,hc⟩
  rw [h_eq_diff n k m (by omega)] at hp
  omega

end ChenJia
```
